correctness.rationale: Affine shear and scaling reduce every nondegenerate positive-base trapezoid to horizontal sections [-r(z),r(z)], r(z)=1-(1-t)z. For center (x,y), each slice has overlap <= twice the lesser radius, with equality at x=0, uniquely globally because at z=y any x !=0 strictly reduces positive-measure overlap. At x=0 direct slice integration yields A(y)=4m(1-(1-t)y)-2(1-t)m^2, m=min(y,1-y). Its lower branch 4y-6(1-t)y^2 and strictly decreasing upper branch give unique y=1/[3(1-t)] for 0<t<=1/3 and y=1/2 for 1/3<=t<=1. Dividing by area (1+t) gives kappa=2/[3(1-t^2)] or (1+3t)/[2(1+t)]. Derivatives match C1 at t=1/3 with right-minus-left second derivative -27/8; near t=0 kappa-2/3=(2/3)t^2+O(t^4), yielding sharp inverse 1/2-Hoelder. Case t=1 parallelogram checked separately. Independent convex-polygon intersection using Shapely checked five rational shape/center profiles; the continuous maximization is analytic, not proved by sampling.
